newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia to issue $31.6 mln three-yr six pct bond.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia to issue $31.6 mln three-yr six pct bond.

text.p: Slovenia's Finance Ministry said on Wednesday it had completed an auction for a three-year six percent bond that will be issued on July 23 to the value of 5.16 billion tolars ($31.6 million).
The ministry said 14 out of 28 Slovenian banks participated in the auction, and it had accepted all offers that covered at least 99 percent of the nominal value of the bonds.

The bonds, which will be used to cover the budget deficit, will be denominated in 100,000 tolars and will carry an interest rate of six percent over Slovenia's basic interest rate TOM. Interest rates will be paid bi-annually.
TOM, which changes monthly according to the rate of inflation over the past 12 months, reflected a monthly rate of 0.7 percent in July.
Slovenia expects to have a budget deficit of 26.7 billion tolars in the first nine months of this year. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439 ($ = 163.2 Slovenian Tolars)
